answer: I'd like to talk about the time I got lost in Chattogram, a city I had never visited before. It was about three years ago, when I went there with some university friends on a short study tour. A time I got hopelessly lost was during that trip, when I wandered off from my group one afternoon to explore the older part of the city near the port. Before long I realised I had no idea where I was, and to make matters worse, my phone battery had died. I felt a growing sense of [[panic]] as the narrow lanes all started to look the same, and I was completely [[disoriented]]. Rather than making it worse by rushing, I forced myself to [[keep a level head]] and think logically. I asked a friendly shopkeeper for directions, and although his local dialect was quite hard for me to follow, he was very patient and even drew me a little map on a scrap of paper. Eventually I found my way back to a landmark I recognised and reunited with my relieved group, who had been searching for me for nearly an hour. I felt rather [[sheepish]], and my friends teased me about it for the rest of the trip. Looking back, although it was stressful at the time, it turned into a strangely memorable [[escapade]]. It taught me to pay more attention to my surroundings and always memorise a few key landmarks. Honestly, getting lost made me a more careful traveller.

followUps.q: Do you usually rely on your phone for directions?
followUps.answer: Yes, far too much, if I am honest. Since that day, though, I always make sure my phone is charged, and I try to notice a couple of landmarks wherever I go.

followUps.q: Have you been back to Chattogram since then?
followUps.answer: Once, for work, to attend an education fair. This time I stayed close to the venue, but I did recognise the lane where the kind shopkeeper had helped me, which made me smile.

note: Set in Chattogram on a university study tour (dialect instead of language barrier); plain marks 'calm', 'helpful', 'memorable' replaced by 'disoriented', 'keep a level head', 'sheepish', 'escapade'.
